title: An Inverse Obstacle Problem for the Fractional Schrödinger Equation
summary: We study an inverse obstacle problem for the fractional Schrödinger operator $(-Δ)^s+q$, $0<s<1$. For each exterior datum, the state is constrained by a prescribed obstacle in a bounded domain and satisfies the fractional Schrödinger equation only in the associated noncontact set. This set is unknown and depends on the coefficient, so the exterior Dirichlet-to-Neumann map is nonlinear. We show that the nonlocal character of the equation gives a direct way around this moving-free-boundary difficulty.
